question: How do two baseline-matched published hepatic relations change the BC-008 secretion contrast, separately and together?

source.locators: p1743 Table I normal column and equations4-7; p1744 equations10-12
source.native_m5: archive but do not use: unused profile coefficient, individual ancestry not established
source.literal_coefficients: evaluate baseline mismatch only; do not simulate an unbalanced drop-in as a mechanism effect

inherits: exact BC-008 profile, source coefficients, basal replacement, initial gastric stimulus, 240 min, 0.25-min reports, all three solvers and runtime

relations.HE: HEb - m5*(S-Sb) when extraction enabled; else HEb
relations.m3: m30 + m1*(HE-HEb)/((1-HE)*(1-HEb)); equals HE*m1/(1-HE), exact m30 at baseline
relations.m6_effective: HEb + m5*Sb; engineering reanchoring using source eq6, not fitted
relations.EGP: max(kp1-kp2*Gp-kp3*Id-kp4*(P-P0),0) when portal enabled; otherwise original native EGP
relations.kp1_effective: native kp1 + kp4*P0; engineering reanchoring using source eq12, not fitted
relations.ownership: replace native m30 loss in guarded liver derivative and its ledger; replace EGP in guarded plasma glucose derivative; use corrected Gdot in source at same stage; no second liver input or peripheral clearance change

failure_policy: terminate on HE boundary, BC-008 glucose envelope or negative physical amount; retain event time and last state, all other cases and incomplete-case denominator; never clip HE or conceal an unsupported domain

analysis.contrasts: feedback_full minus constant_basal within each hepatic variant; change in this contrast versus fixed; both-extraction-portal+fixed interaction
analysis.numerical_resolution: absolute contrast >=10 times largest change of the same contrast across coarse/tight/reference, denominator floor epsilon*(1+abs(reference)); zero and unresolved retained
analysis.coefficient_uncertainty: switching relations on/off is a structural diagnostic, not a confidence interval or a population range
analysis.identifiability: no fitting; assess required observations and confounding, not human parameter recovery
analysis.publication_reproduction: equation-level relations only; no full healthy/T2D cohort reproduction
